resources.string: Ask a parent to call me
Your parents call you on your own number. SOS and 112 work as before.
Waiting for a connection. The request is sent as soon as the phone is online.
Your request is saved. Your parents see it as soon as they open the app.
Your parents have been asked to call you.
A parent has answered your request.
Nobody answered within 24 hours. Call or text your parents yourself.
The request could not be sent. Call or text your parents yourself.
You can ask your parents to call you back from SOS. They call the number they saved for your phone. The request does not send any number.
